recovery_position: Resolve review_snapshot_commit from the canonical program, enumerate git rev-list <baseline_commit>..<review_snapshot_commit>, and revert every returned commit newest-to-oldest as one bounded operation.
limitations: Execute in a clean disposable checkout and preserve the candidate reference before recovery.
The range must be linear; merge commits fail certification until explicit mainline handling is supported.
Rollback restores repository-controlled source, governance contracts, templates, and runbooks only.
GitHub issues and their history are durable provider records and are not deleted by repository rollback.
Collaborator onboarding and a monitored private conduct destination require owner action and are never synthesized or destructively rolled back by automation.
The integrated audit certifies bounded static repository controls and authenticated provider observations, not deployments, adoption, or SEO outcomes.
